finding_dispositions.evidence: Sequential sibling container frames are retained until document completion; registry validation lacks WorkContext and stable limit errors.
Successful applicator and ref annotations now propagate and counterexamples pass.
Predicate registry is exact, digest/code-bound, built-in-only, immutable, and capability-free.
ErrorRuleRegistry now validates digest-locked rule/code/phase triples.
Migration accepts arbitrary caller validators before charge and does not verify expected old digest.
Several numbered conformance families execute summary/template algorithms instead of independent production-equivalent contracts.
CompatibilityMatrix.readers is mutable after digest verification.

findings.claim: Resource temporary lifetimes and public registry accounting remain non-normative.
findings.evidence: temporary_units=4 rejects b'[[],[]]' although normative live peak is four; validation has no context.
findings.required_change: Release frame units at close, retain only container content until freeze, charge canonical work before allocation, and return stable E_LIMIT for registry limits.

findings.claim: Migration permits injected validators and omits pinned-old-digest verification.
findings.evidence: Caller validator runs before executable charge and API only computes source digest.
findings.required_change: Use closed registry validators, charge before invocation, require constant-time old digest verification, and compare exact provenance/output bytes.

findings.claim: The 250 case suite is nominal rather than production-equivalent for several families.
findings.evidence: Budget cases directly call emit; Node migration omits registry/digest/cost/provenance; schema is a small subset; summaries omit exact records/traces.
findings.required_change: Replace templates with requirement-specific independent algorithms and exact bytes/errors/traces/provenance plus per-case digests.

findings.claim: Compatibility behavior remains mutable without digest change.
findings.evidence: Replacing a readers map entry makes an undeclared writer pass.
findings.required_change: Deep-freeze every compatibility and migration registry mapping and test post-load mutation.
